metadata.title: Meet the Founder | Green Garden
metadata.description: Meet the person behind Green Garden — a personal story of growing, caring for, and sharing plants with others.

ownerHero.title: Plants have always been part of my story.
ownerHero.description: Green Garden started from a simple love for growing, caring for, and sharing plants with others.
ownerHero.imageAlt: Portrait of the Green Garden founder among indoor plants

ownerStory.introTitle: Meet the person behind Green Garden.
ownerStory.introDescription: I first fell in love with plants by watching them grow — slowly, patiently, and full of quiet wonder. That curiosity grew into a habit of learning what each plant needs, and a joy in helping friends find the right green companion for their homes.
ownerStory.introImageAlt: A calm plant corner with warm natural light
ownerStory.journeyTitle: From a love of plants to Green Garden.
ownerStory.journeyParagraph1: Green Garden began when I realized how many people wanted plants in their lives, but felt unsure where to start. Choosing a plant should feel inspiring, not overwhelming.
ownerStory.journeyParagraph2: I started carefully selecting healthy plants, learning their habits, and sharing practical guidance — so every home could feel a little more alive.
ownerStory.journeyParagraph3: Today, Green Garden is still guided by that same intention: help you find a plant that fits your space, your routine, and the way you want to live.
ownerStory.journeyImageAlt: Healthy nursery plants arranged in soft natural light

ownerPhilosophy.title: Every plant has a place where it can thrive.
ownerPhilosophy.description: I believe the best plant is not always the rarest or most beautiful one. It is the one that fits your space, your lifestyle, and the way you want to live.

healthyPlants.title: Healthy Plants
healthyPlants.description: Every plant should arrive healthy, carefully prepared, and ready to settle into its new home.

honestGuidance.title: Honest Guidance
honestGuidance.description: We recommend plants based on your space and routine, not simply what is trending.

growingTogether.title: Growing Together
growingTogether.description: Green Garden is here to help you become more confident in caring for your plants.

ownerNote.title: Thank you for growing with us.
ownerNote.description: Every order from Green Garden is more than a sale. It is another plant finding a new home and another person beginning or continuing their plant journey.
ownerNote.name: The Founder
ownerNote.imageAlt: Small portrait of the Green Garden founder

metadata.title: FAQ | Green Garden
metadata.description: Find answers about plants, delivery, orders, care, returns, and everything in between at Green Garden.

hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.description: Find answers about plants, delivery, orders, care, and everything in between.

contact.title: Still have questions?
contact.description: We're happy to help you find the right plant and answer any questions you may have.

placeOrder.question: How do I place an order?
placeOrder.answer: Browse our plants, choose your pot size and color if available, add items to your cart, and continue to checkout to complete your order.

changeOrder.question: Can I change my order after placing it?
changeOrder.answer: If your order has not yet been prepared for delivery, contact us as soon as possible and we will do our best to update it.

multiplePlants.question: Can I order multiple plants at once?
multiplePlants.answer: Yes. You can add as many plants as you like to your cart and check out in a single order.

deliveryTime.question: How long does delivery take?
deliveryTime.answer: Most local orders arrive within 3–5 business days. Express options may be available at checkout depending on your area.

sameDay.question: Do you offer same-day delivery?
sameDay.answer: Same-day delivery is limited to select areas and order times. If it is available for your location, you will see it during checkout.

packaging.question: How are plants packaged for delivery?
packaging.answer: Each plant is carefully secured to protect the stems, leaves, and soil so it arrives healthy and ready for its new home.

outsideCity.question: Do you deliver outside the city?
outsideCity.answer: Yes, we deliver to many nearby areas. Shipping availability and timing are confirmed at checkout based on your address.

watering.question: How often should I water my plant?
watering.answer: It depends on the plant, light, and season. As a starting point, water when the top layer of soil feels dry, and always check your plant’s care guide.

sunlight.question: How much sunlight does my plant need?
sunlight.answer: Most of our indoor plants prefer bright, indirect light. Each product page includes specific light guidance for that plant.

losingLeaves.question: What happens if my plant starts losing leaves?
losingLeaves.answer: Some leaf drop is normal after moving. Check watering, light, and temperature first. If you are unsure, reach out and we can help you troubleshoot.

petSafety.question: Are your plants safe for pets?
petSafety.answer: Not all plants are pet-safe. Look for our pet-friendly labels, or contact us and we will help you choose a safer option for your home.

potSize.question: Can I choose the pot size?
potSize.answer: Yes. Where size options are available, you can select your preferred pot size on the product page before adding the plant to your cart.

potColor.question: Can I choose the pot color?
potColor.answer: Many plants offer pot color options. Choose your preferred color on the product page when selecting your plant.

plantsWithPots.question: Do plants come with pots?
plantsWithPots.answer: Most plants are sold with a nursery or decorative pot as shown on the product page. Details are listed for each item.

returnPolicy.question: What is your return policy?
returnPolicy.answer: Because plants are living products, returns are limited. Please contact us within 48 hours if there is an issue with your order and we will help find a fair solution.

damagedPlant.question: What if my plant arrives damaged?
damagedPlant.answer: Please send us photos within 48 hours of delivery. If a plant arrives damaged, we will arrange a replacement or another suitable resolution.

exchangePlant.question: Can I exchange a plant?
exchangePlant.answer: Exchanges may be possible for unopened or unused items, depending on plant condition and availability. Contact us and we will review your request.

whereGrown.question: Where are your plants grown?
whereGrown.answer: Our plants are carefully selected from trusted local growers and nurseries so they are healthy, well-adapted, and ready for your space.

payment.question: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.answer: We accept major cards and other secure payment options shown at checkout. Your payment details are processed safely during order completion.

contactUs.question: How can I contact Green Garden?
contactUs.answer: Use the contact details in our footer or reach out through the Contact Us link. We are happy to help with plant selection, orders, and care questions.
